attempted_claim: Let BPHP_n be the bit pigeonhole principle with n+1 pigeons and n holes for n a power of 2, with N=(n+1)*log2(n) query bits, and let F_n = Search(BPHP_n) o IND_3^N where IND_3 is the constant-size Index gadget (Alice holds 1-bit pointer i, Bob holds 2-bit string y, output y_i). Then for every n >= 16 a power of 2, the randomized two-party communication complexity R^{cc}(F_n) >= n/16, hence via Karchmer-Wigderson the associated monotone Boolean function requires monotone formula size at least 2^{n/16}. Binary test: the stated inequality for all such n with a logged lifting-plus-KW certificate.
claim_type: constant-size-gadget query-to-communication lifting with monotone formula size corollary
decisive_failure: ['Neither target nor fallback proved or disproved; residual is the documented open constant-size Index lifting conjecture (Beame-Koroth).', 'Computed evidence consists of small exact censuses (2x4 gadget, 3-bit minimax) and elementary counting/birthday arithmetic, not a lifting proof.', 'No refuting protocol found for either claim; binary tests remain open at n>=512 (fallback) and all n>=16 (target).']
